quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Dallas Mavericks' potential impact
quotes.excerpt: Who is a team that's outside that you could look at could actually shift some things up?
quotes.quote: Who is a team that's outside that you could look at could actually shift some things up? And again, we're not saying Dallas is going to be top six, we're saying if Dallas was eight in the play-in and won the first game and were the seven seed, you wouldn't be like, 'Where did this come from?'

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the narrow margins in the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: That's the window difference between being the 7-8 and the 9-10.
quotes.quote: That's the window difference between being the 7-8 and the 9-10. So it doesn't always have to be like what your overall roster looks like, it's like what's that fraction of difference of those four teams. And a lot of time it's half a game, it's home court, it's the tiebreaker that will decide 9-10 at the end.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts the Orlando Magic will trade Paolo Banchero
quotes.excerpt: The Orlando Magic. They're going to move on from Paolo Banchero eventually.
quotes.quote: The Orlando Magic. They're going to move on from Paolo Banchero eventually. He will be the first All-Star, All-NBA player traded.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson predicts Zion Williamson will be traded
quotes.excerpt: I would say Zion Williamson. I think when you look at the Pelicans, obviously he looks like he's in great shape.
quotes.quote: I would say Zion Williamson. I think when you look at the Pelicans, obviously he looks like he's in great shape. Their team, I think there was enough conversation, so if they had an opportunity, it's hard to to move him at certain times, but if he were to start the season with a strong 25-30 games, I could see that as the time that they would, you know, try and move on.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the impact of the salary cap on player movement
quotes.excerpt: Some you have to make this understand the value. It's sometimes it's because of the cap.
quotes.quote: Some you have to make this understand the value. It's sometimes it's because of the cap. Because of the hard cap. If you don't believe that these teams are the second apron, if you don't believe that us paying two-three different guys that are max salaries that were 23-24, and we're like, 'Okay, this is what they got to get by 25-26,' if you're not looking at that value and you're going to be paying a tax of 30-40 million because you thought these guys might be going to the conference finals and we're stuck in the play-in, you will be, to Perk's point, quicker to move off that.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the financial motivations behind major trades
quotes.excerpt: There's a financial component to some of these moves. LaMelo Ball, there's a financial component to it.
quotes.quote: There's a financial component to some of these moves. LaMelo Ball, there's a financial component to it. Now there might have been other things, but I think there was a financial component to it. And the team that took on LaMelo Ball is a team that's looking to get over the hump, right? That has a young superstar. So it wasn't just, it wasn't like a team that's jumping into the second apron and they only got a couple year window. A lot of it is the structure of the league versus I think the way the teams value these guys' ability and talent.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Cleveland Cavaliers' high payroll
quotes.excerpt: Cleveland, everybody had Cleveland 4-5-6, but they got the second highest payroll in the NBA.
quotes.quote: Cleveland, everybody had Cleveland 4-5-6, but they got the second highest payroll in the NBA. That's crazy. And they couldn't retain a bunch of their players like Dean Wade, but to me, Cleveland is another team that I think they're going to have to look at that team. If you're Cleveland, everybody had Cleveland 4-5-6, but they got the second highest payroll in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson identifies the Knicks and Thunder as high-tax teams
quotes.excerpt: The one team that's up there very, very high that when we start talking about the repeater tax, it is the New York Knicks and the Oklahoma City Thunder.
quotes.quote: The one team that's up there very, very high that when we start talking about the repeater tax, it is the New York Knicks and the Oklahoma City Thunder. Those are the two teams that are still very, very high after after this current season. So they have to probably make salary cutting moves. The Knicks make so much money that they are a team that can stay there. Oklahoma City doesn't have the same latitude as the New York Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson picks Cooper Flagg as a first-time All-Star
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a very easy answer. Cooper Flagg.
quotes.quote: I think it's a very easy answer. Cooper Flagg.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains the 'most improved' player criteria
quotes.excerpt: The most improved always goes to a top player that ends up making like his first All-Star game.
quotes.quote: The most improved always goes to a top player that ends up making like his first All-Star game. But it's never like, it's never like most improved that comes out of nowhere, right? You get it every once in a while, right? Like I think Dyson Daniels one of a few years ago. But if you often look at most improved and the players that get it, so it would be Cooper Flagg turning into an All-Star and his numbers increasing. It would be a Dylan Harper or a Steph Castle, who's like an All-Star caliber player becoming an All-Star for the first time. That's how Brandon Ingram got it, I think that's how Shai got it. If you look at how like the most improved and who it goes to typically, it's players of that caliber. Like who was up for most improved this year? Deni Avdija was up for most improved, made his first All-Star game.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson believes the 76ers are under the most pressure
quotes.excerpt: Philly's not Philly's under the most pressure, obviously. They're not definitely not going to blow it up.
quotes.quote: Philly's not Philly's under the most pressure, obviously. They're not definitely not going to blow it up. The pressure is to be elite. And an elite that means top three, that means top three in their conference, not necessarily league, because you can do management with the older bodies. There's a lot of different things. Your goal is to have home court, right? You have home court in the first round.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Denver Nuggets' potential for a big trade
quotes.excerpt: I don't really see any team in my opinion that is potential of blow up, I would say one team, Denver Nuggets.
quotes.quote: I don't really see any team in my opinion that is potential of blow up, I would say one team, Denver Nuggets, but I wouldn't say that they're in a blow up position. They would do a big shift. They might make a big trade because Jokic, you would hope that you got more than one finals out of Jokic and him being the best player in the world for probably the last four to five years, and the three MVPs that he's gotten. So I look at that and say like that window, I don't necessarily say it's closing, but that window, I think two to three more years of him being a top five player in this league, undoubtedly.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson predicts the Orlando Magic will be a mid-tier team
quotes.excerpt: Orlando will be mid this year. Orlando's going to be 8-9-10 again in the play-in again.
quotes.quote: Orlando will be mid this year. Orlando's going to be 8-9-10 again in the play-in again. They're going to have shooting issues again. It's just it's you know.
